answer_1.quote: Simultaneous machine translation models are widely applied in communication scenarios, eliminating barriers between individuals with different linguistic backgrounds.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates speech output directly without the need to produce intermediate target text tokens before receiving the complete input to maintain synchrony between the listener and speaker.

answer_2.quote: Translation quality is assessed using case-sensitive detokenized BLEU (Papineni et al., 2002; Post, 2018), while latency is measured by word-level Average Lagging (AL; Ma et al., 2020c).
